A '''yobshrimp''' was a carnivorous crustacean native to the shallow waters of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], particularly the area of [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]]. These clawed creatures were considered a dangerous delicacy by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], due to the fact they were served as a live [[Cocktail/Legends|cocktail]].  

They sometimes lived inside the gills of the [[Tee/Legends|tee]], and were eaten from them by [[Laa/Legends|laa]]. They were natural competitors with [[Yobcrab/Legends|yobcrabs]] and were the common prey of the [[Blarth/Legends|blarth]] and the predatory [[Scalefish/Legends|scalefish]].<ref name="WoSW">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>
